legend: You just looked at a flier for the upcoming inter-university bowling tournament. Your university is looking for a team to represent it, but you're still hesitating on applying as you think you're not good enough. Meanwhile, you got more interested in the problem of how the team should be formed.

For the tournament, a team should consist of K$$$K$$$ people, and you know that N$$$N$$$ participants from your university have applied to represent it. You're totally convinced that the skill of a team is determined by its weakest link, meaning the team member with the lowest ability. Thus, for a team T$$$T$$$ where each member has a bowling ability of ai$$$a_i$$$ (1≤i≤|T|$$$1 \leq i \leq |T|$$$), the total ability of the team is the minimum across all members (Ta=min(a1,a2,…a|T|$$$T_a = min(a_1, a_2, \dots a_{|T|}$$$). Your university has a special characteristic where the abilities of the N$$$N$$$ registered participants are unique, thus forming a permutation of integers from 1…N$$$1 \dots N$$$.

You want to know the sum of the abilities of each of the representing teams of K$$$K$$$ members that could be formed from the N$$$N$$$ registered participants, taking into account how the team's ability is calculated.
You would like to compute the previous value for a lot of pairs of team size (K$$$K$$$) and registered participants (N$$$N$$$), but you got to do it fast before your university's team gets selected!
input: In the first line, you're given an integer Q$$$Q$$$ −$$$-$$$ (1≤Q≤105$$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^5$$$) −$$$-$$$ the number of queries you will be asked.

For each of the next Q$$$Q$$$ lines, you will get two integers N$$$N$$$ and K$$$K$$$ −$$$-$$$ (1≤K≤N≤106$$$1\leq K \leq N \leq 10^6$$$) −$$$-$$$ the number of registered participants and the size that the teams should have, respectively.
output: For each of the Q$$$Q$$$ lines, you should print one integer, the answer to the query. Since the answer can be pretty big, print it modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: 你刚刚看到了即将举行的校际保龄球锦标赛的传单。你的大学正在寻找一支代表队，但你仍在犹豫是否报名，因为你觉得自己不够优秀。与此同时，你对如何组建队伍这个问题越来越感兴趣。

参加锦标赛的队伍应由 K$$$K$$$ 人组成，你知道本校有 N$$$N$$$ 名参赛者报名代表学校参赛。你坚信，队伍的实力由最弱的一环决定，也就是能力最低的队员。因此，对于一支队伍 T$$$T$$$，若每名队员的保龄球能力为 ai$$$a_i$$$(1≤i≤|T|$$$1 \leq i \leq |T|$$$)，则队伍的总能力等于所有队员能力的最小值(Ta=min(a1,a2,…a|T|$$$T_a = min(a_1, a_2, \dots a_{|T|}$$$)。你的大学有一项特殊之处：N$$$N$$$ 名已报名参赛者的能力各不相同，因此这些能力构成了从 1…N$$$1 \dots N$$$ 中取值的一个排列。
你想知道，从 N$$$N$$$ 名已报名参赛者中选出 K$$$K$$$ 人组成队伍后，所有可能代表队的能力之和是多少，其中队伍能力按照上述方式计算。
你想针对许多组队伍规模(K$$$K$$$)和已报名参赛者人数(N$$$N$$$)计算上述结果，但你必须尽快完成，赶在本校代表队选拔结束之前！

input.ai: 第一行给出一个整数 Q$$$Q$$$ −$$$-$$$(1≤Q≤105$$$1 \leq Q \leq 10^5$$$)−$$$-$$$，表示你将收到的查询数量。
对于接下来的 Q$$$Q$$$ 行，每行你将得到两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 K$$$K$$$ −$$$-$$$(1≤K≤N≤106$$$1\leq K \leq N \leq 10^6$$$)−$$$-$$$，它们分别表示已报名的参赛者人数以及每支队伍应有的规模。

output.ai: 对于 Q$$$Q$$$ 行中的每一行，你都应输出一个整数，即该查询的答案。由于答案可能非常大，请输出答案对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
